note_tweet.text:
Saw GLM-Legal getting a lot of discussion on HN. Quick answers to the questions people have been asking:

- Open source: It's on the plan. We want to make sure the capabilities are solid enough first.
- Benchmark credibility: We improved both Harvey-style tasks and other formats. The model should generalize well across different types of legal work.
- Legal systems: Both Western law and Chinese law got a boost.
